# Salesforce Omni-Channel CDC channel configuration and topic validation — facts

## Definitions

- [statement] `SelectedEntity` is the selected entity’s change-event name; the Tooling API example for Account uses `AccountChangeEvent`. (low confidence) — https://developer.salesforce.com/docs/platform/api-tooling/references/tooling-objects/tooling-platformeventchannelmember.html · keywords: Salesforce Omni-Channel CDC channel configuration and topic validation

## Structure and components

- [statement] SelectedEntity is the change-event name of the selected entity; FilterExpression contains a SOQL-based expression with a supported subset of operators and field types. (low confidence) — https://developer.salesforce.com/docs/platform/api-tooling/references/tooling-objects/tooling-platformeventchannelmember.html · keywords: Salesforce Omni-Channel CDC channel configuration and topic validation

## How it works

- [statement] Attributed event-name conflict: the Omni guide’s Apex introductory prose says `AgentWorkPresenceChangeEvent`, while its Apex trigger declaration and channel-member XML use `AgentWorkChangeEvent`. (low confidence) — https://developer.salesforce.com/docs/service/service-presence-developer-guide/guide/omnichannel-external-routing-subscribe-to-change-data-capture-event-notificat.html · keywords: Salesforce Omni-Channel CDC channel configuration and topic validation
- [statement] Design inference, proposed capability step: call GetTopic for the candidate topic under the intended authentication context; compare returned topic_name and tenant_guid with the expected identity, record can_subscribe and can_publish separately, and retain schema_id and rpc_id. Treat a false subscription flag as a failed capability check, not as proof of a particular permission cause. (medium confidence) — https://raw.githubusercontent.com/forcedotcom/pub-sub-api/main/pubsub_api.proto · keywords: Salesforce Omni-Channel CDC channel configuration and topic validation · also: https://developer.salesforce.com/docs/platform/pub-sub-api/references/methods/gettopic-rpc.html

## Problems, failure modes and limitations

- [statement] Pub/Sub error inspection exposes a gRPC status and description/details, a custom error code in exception trailers, and an RPC ID in the message and trailers. (low confidence) — https://developer.salesforce.com/docs/platform/pub-sub-api/guide/handling-errors.html · keywords: Salesforce Omni-Channel CDC channel configuration and topic validation
- [statement] The documented topic error sfdc.platform.eventbus.grpc.topic.meta.permission maps to PERMISSION_DENIED: An error occurred while getting the metadata for the specified topic. Ensure the credentials and topic name are correct. (low confidence) — https://developer.salesforce.com/docs/platform/pub-sub-api/guide/handling-errors.html · keywords: Salesforce Omni-Channel CDC channel configuration and topic validation
- [statement] The documented topic error sfdc.platform.eventbus.grpc.topic.not.found maps to NOT_FOUND: The topic information for the specified topic wasn’t found. Ensure that the topic name is correct and the topic exists. (low confidence) — https://developer.salesforce.com/docs/platform/pub-sub-api/guide/handling-errors.html · keywords: Salesforce Omni-Channel CDC channel configuration and topic validation
- [statement] The documented topic error sfdc.platform.eventbus.grpc.topic.api.unavailable maps to UNAVAILABLE: The topic information is unavailable for the specified topic. (low confidence) — https://developer.salesforce.com/docs/platform/pub-sub-api/guide/handling-errors.html · keywords: Salesforce Omni-Channel CDC channel configuration and topic validation
- [statement] The documented topic error sfdc.platform.eventbus.grpc.topic.validation.empty maps to INVALID_ARGUMENT: An error occurred while validating the topic information provided. The topic can’t be blank. (low confidence) — https://developer.salesforce.com/docs/platform/pub-sub-api/guide/handling-errors.html · keywords: Salesforce Omni-Channel CDC channel configuration and topic validation
- [statement] Proposed read-only procedure, design inference: on topic-lookup failure, preserve the gRPC status, custom error code, and RPC ID; classify blank input, missing topic, metadata-permission failure, and unavailable information separately. Correct or investigate the indicated cause before repeating the lookup; a failure does not justify rewriting the configured topic automatically. (medium confidence) — https://developer.salesforce.com/docs/platform/pub-sub-api/guide/handling-errors.html · keywords: Salesforce Omni-Channel CDC channel configuration and topic validation · also: https://developer.salesforce.com/docs/platform/change-data-capture/guide/cdc-filter-subscribe.html
- [statement] Design inference, proposed error-handling step: record status, custom trailer error code, and RPC ID. On topic metadata permission failure, recheck both credentials and topic name; on not-found, recheck the name and existence; on empty-topic validation failure, fix the input; on unavailable-topic information, classify validation as inconclusive and retry under an operational retry policy. (medium confidence) — https://developer.salesforce.com/docs/platform/pub-sub-api/guide/handling-errors.html · keywords: Salesforce Omni-Channel CDC channel configuration and topic validation · also: https://developer.salesforce.com/docs/platform/pub-sub-api/references/methods/gettopic-rpc.html
- [statement] The subscription error sfdc.platform.eventbus.grpc.subscription.topic.cannot.subscribe maps to PERMISSION_DENIED and directs the caller to check required permissions. (low confidence) — https://developer.salesforce.com/docs/platform/pub-sub-api/guide/handling-errors.html · keywords: Salesforce Omni-Channel CDC channel configuration and topic validation

## Comparisons and alternatives

- [statement] Attributed naming conflict: the Omni guide gives the subscription setting /data/ExternalRoutingChannel_chn, while its member XML uses ExternalRoutingChannel__chn and the CDC subscription guide specifies /data/ChannelName__chn. Preserve these spellings as source positions rather than silently correcting the Omni text. (medium confidence) — https://developer.salesforce.com/docs/service/service-presence-developer-guide/guide/omnichannel-external-routing-subscribe-to-change-data-capture-event-notificat.html · keywords: Salesforce Omni-Channel CDC channel configuration and topic validation · also: https://developer.salesforce.com/docs/platform/change-data-capture/guide/cdc-filter-subscribe.html
- [statement] Proposed read-only procedure, design inference: inspect each associated member individually for `SelectedEntity`, `FilterExpression`, `FullName`, and `Metadata`; compare the selected entities and predicates with the intended contract. When the Omni sample is the contract, retain its literal presence predicate rather than rewriting OR as AND. (medium confidence) — https://developer.salesforce.com/docs/platform/api-tooling/references/tooling-objects/tooling-platformeventchannelmember.html · keywords: Salesforce Omni-Channel CDC channel configuration and topic validation · also: https://developer.salesforce.com/docs/service/service-presence-developer-guide/guide/omnichannel-external-routing-subscribe-to-change-data-capture-event-notificat.html
- [statement] Design inference, proposed identity step: form the candidate topic by prefixing the retrieved channel FullName with /data/, retaining its namespace and __chn suffix. Record the Omni single-underscore subscription spelling as a discrepancy to resolve, rather than deriving a topic from the member DeveloperName. (medium confidence) — https://developer.salesforce.com/docs/platform/api-tooling/references/tooling-objects/tooling-platformeventchannel.html · keywords: Salesforce Omni-Channel CDC channel configuration and topic validation · also: https://developer.salesforce.com/docs/platform/api-tooling/references/tooling-objects/tooling-platformeventchannelmember.html, https://developer.salesforce.com/docs/platform/change-data-capture/guide/cdc-filter-subscribe.html, https://developer.salesforce.com/docs/service/service-presence-developer-guide/guide/omnichannel-external-routing-subscribe-to-change-data-capture-event-notificat.html

## Facts and statements

- [statement] The documented Omni example selects UserServicePresenceChangeEvent on ExternalRoutingChannel__chn and uses exactly: ChangeEventHeader.changeType = 'CREATE' OR (IsCurrentState = false). This is the documented example, including OR and parentheses. (low confidence) — https://developer.salesforce.com/docs/service/service-presence-developer-guide/guide/omnichannel-external-routing-subscribe-to-change-data-capture-event-notificat.html · keywords: Salesforce Omni-Channel CDC channel configuration and topic validation · also: https://developer.salesforce.com/docs/platform/change-data-capture/guide/cdc-event-fields-header.html
- [statement] The Omni example for PendingServiceRoutingChangeEvent uses RoutingModel = 'ExternalRouting' AND IsReadyForRouting = true. (low confidence) — https://developer.salesforce.com/docs/service/service-presence-developer-guide/guide/omnichannel-external-routing-subscribe-to-change-data-capture-event-notificat.html · keywords: Salesforce Omni-Channel CDC channel configuration and topic validation
- [statement] The Omni Pub/Sub example for AgentWorkChangeEvent uses ChangeEventHeader.changeType = 'UPDATE' AND RoutingModel = 'ExternalRouting'. (low confidence) — https://developer.salesforce.com/docs/service/service-presence-developer-guide/guide/omnichannel-external-routing-subscribe-to-change-data-capture-event-notificat.html · keywords: Salesforce Omni-Channel CDC channel configuration and topic validation · also: https://developer.salesforce.com/docs/platform/change-data-capture/guide/cdc-event-fields-header.html
- [statement] Tooling API retrieval or query of either channel object requires View Setup and Configuration permission. (medium confidence) — https://developer.salesforce.com/docs/platform/api-tooling/references/tooling-objects/tooling-platformeventchannel.html · keywords: Salesforce Omni-Channel CDC channel configuration and topic validation · also: https://developer.salesforce.com/docs/platform/api-tooling/references/tooling-objects/tooling-platformeventchannelmember.html
- [statement] Tooling API supports enumerating custom channels with SELECT Id, DeveloperName, ChannelType, MasterLabel FROM PlatformEventChannel; its documentation excludes querying the standard ChangeEvents channel this way. - [statement] The channel DeveloperName excludes the __chn suffix; FullName includes that suffix and can include a namespace prefix. (low confidence) — https://developer.salesforce.com/docs/platform/api-tooling/references/tooling-objects/tooling-platformeventchannel.html · keywords: Salesforce Omni-Channel CDC channel configuration and topic validation
- [statement] The channel `ChannelType` value `data` identifies a Change Data Capture channel corresponding to selected entities. (low confidence) — https://developer.salesforce.com/docs/platform/api-tooling/references/tooling-objects/tooling-platformeventchannel.html · keywords: Salesforce Omni-Channel CDC channel configuration and topic validation
- [statement] For both channel objects, queries selecting FullName or Metadata must return no more than one record; the documentation instructs using multiple queries to retrieve multiple records. (medium confidence) — https://developer.salesforce.com/docs/platform/api-tooling/references/tooling-objects/tooling-platformeventchannel.html · keywords: Salesforce Omni-Channel CDC channel configuration and topic validation · also: https://developer.salesforce.com/docs/platform/api-tooling/references/tooling-objects/tooling-platformeventchannelmember.html
- [statement] Tooling API supports enumerating members with SELECT Id,DeveloperName,EventChannel,SelectedEntity FROM PlatformEventChannelMember. - [statement] For custom channels, queried EventChannel values are channel IDs with prefix 0YL; the member field definition separately describes custom channel names in MyChannel__chn form. (low confidence) — https://developer.salesforce.com/docs/platform/api-tooling/references/tooling-objects/tooling-platformeventchannelmember.html · keywords: Salesforce Omni-Channel CDC channel configuration and topic validation
- [statement] A member name can use MyChannel_chn_AccountChangeEvent while its destination channel is MyChannel__chn; the single underscore in that member name is not the custom-channel suffix convention. (low confidence) — https://developer.salesforce.com/docs/platform/api-tooling/references/tooling-objects/tooling-platformeventchannelmember.html · keywords: Salesforce Omni-Channel CDC channel configuration and topic validation
- [statement] Proposed read-only procedure, design inference: begin with the documented channel discovery query, select the intended channel ID, and confirm its `ChannelType` is `data` before proceeding. (low confidence) — https://developer.salesforce.com/docs/platform/api-tooling/references/tooling-objects/tooling-platformeventchannel.html · keywords: Salesforce Omni-Channel CDC channel configuration and topic validation
- [statement] Proposed read-only procedure, design inference: retrieve the selected channel’s `FullName` and `Metadata` using a query restricted to that individual record; preserve any namespace in the returned full name. (low confidence) — https://developer.salesforce.com/docs/platform/api-tooling/references/tooling-objects/tooling-platformeventchannel.html · keywords: Salesforce Omni-Channel CDC channel configuration and topic validation
- [statement] Proposed read-only procedure, design inference: use the member discovery query and associate custom-channel members by matching the returned `EventChannel` ID to the chosen channel ID. (low confidence) — https://developer.salesforce.com/docs/platform/api-tooling/references/tooling-objects/tooling-platformeventchannelmember.html · keywords: Salesforce Omni-Channel CDC channel configuration and topic validation
- [statement] Proposed read-only procedure, design inference: use the documented `/data/ChannelName__chn` format with the selected channel's full name, including its namespace and suffix, then send that exact candidate to `GetTopic`. (medium confidence) — https://developer.salesforce.com/docs/platform/api-tooling/references/tooling-objects/tooling-platformeventchannel.html · keywords: Salesforce Omni-Channel CDC channel configuration and topic validation · also: https://developer.salesforce.com/docs/platform/change-data-capture/guide/cdc-filter-subscribe.html, https://developer.salesforce.com/docs/platform/pub-sub-api/references/methods/gettopic-rpc.html
- [statement] GetTopic receives TopicRequest and returns TopicInfo. TopicRequest's topic_name field specifies the topic; the authentication headers implicitly identify the tenant/org. (medium confidence) — https://developer.salesforce.com/docs/platform/pub-sub-api/references/methods/gettopic-rpc.html · keywords: Salesforce Omni-Channel CDC channel configuration and topic validation · also: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/forcedotcom/pub-sub-api/main/pubsub_api.proto
- [statement] The primary protocol requires RPC authentication metadata headers `accesstoken`, `instanceurl`, and `tenantid` for Salesforce session-token authentication. (low confidence) — https://raw.githubusercontent.com/forcedotcom/pub-sub-api/main/pubsub_api.proto · keywords: Salesforce Omni-Channel CDC channel configuration and topic validation
- [statement] Proposed read-only procedure, design inference: use an explicitly identified intended org and principal for the metadata reads and the authenticated topic lookup, and record that context with the comparison; no target-org execution is implied by this proposal. (medium confidence) — https://raw.githubusercontent.com/forcedotcom/pub-sub-api/main/pubsub_api.proto · keywords: Salesforce Omni-Channel CDC channel configuration and topic validation · also: https://developer.salesforce.com/docs/platform/api-tooling/references/tooling-objects/tooling-platformeventchannel.html
- [statement] TopicInfo defines topic_name, tenant_guid, can_publish, can_subscribe, schema_id, and rpc_id. The protocol describes can_publish as whether publishing is allowed and can_subscribe as whether subscription is allowed. (low confidence) — https://raw.githubusercontent.com/forcedotcom/pub-sub-api/main/pubsub_api.proto · keywords: Salesforce Omni-Channel CDC channel configuration and topic validation
- [statement] Proposed read-only procedure, design inference: compare returned `topic_name` with the requested topic, record `tenant_guid`, and require `can_subscribe` before considering the subscription-capability check successful. Record `can_publish` separately without making publishing a prerequisite for this read-only procedure. (medium confidence) — https://raw.githubusercontent.com/forcedotcom/pub-sub-api/main/pubsub_api.proto · keywords: Salesforce Omni-Channel CDC channel configuration and topic validation · also: https://developer.salesforce.com/docs/platform/pub-sub-api/references/methods/gettopic-rpc.html
- [statement] `GetTopic` returns a schema ID in `TopicInfo` that can be passed to `GetSchema` to obtain the event schema. (medium confidence) — https://developer.salesforce.com/docs/platform/pub-sub-api/references/methods/gettopic-rpc.html · keywords: Salesforce Omni-Channel CDC channel configuration and topic validation · also: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/forcedotcom/pub-sub-api/main/pubsub_api.proto
- [statement] Proposed read-only procedure, design inference: record `schema_id` and `rpc_id`; optionally use the returned schema ID for a schema-information lookup as a separate diagnostic step. (medium confidence) — https://raw.githubusercontent.com/forcedotcom/pub-sub-api/main/pubsub_api.proto · keywords: Salesforce Omni-Channel CDC channel configuration and topic validation · also: https://developer.salesforce.com/docs/platform/pub-sub-api/references/methods/gettopic-rpc.html
- [statement] Design inference, verification boundary: successful topic-information lookup and capability inspection establish only the returned metadata and flags in that authentication context. They do not establish actual event delivery or filter-predicate correctness; assess delivery separately with an explicitly authorized subscription and representative events. This proposed procedure ends after read-only metadata/RPC checks and makes no target-org assertion. (medium confidence) — https://raw.githubusercontent.com/forcedotcom/pub-sub-api/main/pubsub_api.proto · keywords: Salesforce Omni-Channel CDC channel configuration and topic validation · also: https://developer.salesforce.com/docs/platform/pub-sub-api/references/methods/gettopic-rpc.html, https://developer.salesforce.com/docs/platform/change-data-capture/guide/cdc-filter-subscribe.html, https://www.outofmemo.com/articles/salesforce-create-filtered-cdc-channel-platformeventchannel
- [statement] Sagar Chaudhari’s independent engineering article recommends verifying the subscriber topic/channel name and testing filter behavior with representative changes; it warns that syntactically valid filters can still be semantically too broad. (low confidence) — https://www.outofmemo.com/articles/salesforce-create-filtered-cdc-channel-platformeventchannel · keywords: Salesforce Omni-Channel CDC channel configuration and topic validation
- [statement] A CDC custom channel uses channel type data; channel members associate change-event entities with that channel. (medium confidence) — https://developer.salesforce.com/docs/platform/api-tooling/references/tooling-objects/tooling-platformeventchannel.html · keywords: Salesforce Omni-Channel CDC channel configuration and topic validation · also: https://developer.salesforce.com/docs/platform/api-tooling/references/tooling-objects/tooling-platformeventchannelmember.html, https://www.outofmemo.com/articles/salesforce-create-filtered-cdc-channel-platformeventchannel
- [statement] Design inference, proposed read-only step: enumerate channels and members with the documented Tooling queries, then join each custom member EventChannel ID to its channel Id before assessing the selected entity and channel type. (medium confidence) — https://developer.salesforce.com/docs/platform/api-tooling/references/tooling-objects/tooling-platformeventchannel.html · keywords: Salesforce Omni-Channel CDC channel configuration and topic validation · also: https://developer.salesforce.com/docs/platform/api-tooling/references/tooling-objects/tooling-platformeventchannelmember.html
- [statement] Design inference, proposed read-only step: for each matched channel and member, retrieve FullName and Metadata in separate queries constrained by the discovered Id to at most one record; inspect the member FilterExpression and SelectedEntity against the intended documented example. Preserve namespaces and the complete filter text. (medium confidence) — https://developer.salesforce.com/docs/platform/api-tooling/references/tooling-objects/tooling-platformeventchannel.html · keywords: Salesforce Omni-Channel CDC channel configuration and topic validation · also: https://developer.salesforce.com/docs/platform/api-tooling/references/tooling-objects/tooling-platformeventchannelmember.html, https://developer.salesforce.com/docs/service/service-presence-developer-guide/guide/omnichannel-external-routing-subscribe-to-change-data-capture-event-notificat.html
